duration.text: The Food science and engineering at Yangzhou University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. High school graduation certificate or pre-graduation certificate issued by the high school attended (applicable only to graduating students) 2. High school transcript 3. University entrance examination results of the home country (if any) 4. Valid passport personal information page 5. All visas to China or residence permits in China (if any) 6. Economic guarantee materials 7. Insurance application form 8. Foreigner's physical examination form

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens, in good physical and mental health; 2. Students applying for the undergraduate program must have a high school diploma or equivalent, have excellent academic performance, be at least 18 years old and no more than 25 years old. Applicants for the master's program must hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent, have excellent academic performance, be at least 18 years old and no more than 40 years old. Students applying for the doctoral program must hold a master's degree or equivalent qualifications, be at least 18 years old, have excellent academic performance, and not exceed 50 years old. (Age calculation is based on May 15, 2025).
